statement: Nothing under core/ or jurisdictions/ differs from og 566c850 in any way, with an empty allowlist, and a failing git is red.
source: coordinator 09-30 (PR #71 review: a skipped or deleted gate test must turn the gate red)

layers.arrival: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec page models it
layers.quint: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec models it
layers.contract: n/a: a gate over the repository (pure/rules); it is not contract code
layers.rig: n/a: a gate over the repository, with no system state for the walk

killers.name: R-GATE-FROZEN the allowlist is empty for good
a rename out of core/ is caught: the old path is listed
a deletion, a mode change, a dirty edit and an untracked file are caught
a failing git is red, never ok: an unknown pin is an error
